scope: Four synthetic business types, eight predeclared selections, 14 production creation actions: eight baseline and six after justified fixes. All unpublished; no forms or external messages sent.

method.capture: Read-only DOM and actual screenshots from standalone authenticated previews. Desktop 1280x860 and mobile browser viewport 390x844.
method.retainedReason: These style prompts were unchanged; their actual baseline observations are retained, not counted as new after-fix model calls.
method.comparison: Distinct main hero/meaningful spatial parameters and service compositions. Colours, fonts and decorative or late narrative sections do not count as new main layouts.

limitations: One result per fixed case per phase, no repeated statistical sample and no guarantee for arbitrary future briefs.
Final comparison mixes six after observations and two explicitly retained baseline studio observations; after phase n=6.
Selected styles permit content adaptation; selected templates preserve structural roles, not example text or exact pixels.
Existing sites are not rewritten. Explicit owner layout instructions can override selection.
Browser mobile viewport is not a physical phone test. Contrast and DOM checks are not a full accessibility audit.

Same-style outputs across businesses can share main compositions. After soft-clay used center-stage twice; after clear-product used feature-plus-list twice. This is coherent style reuse, not universal uniqueness.
No physical asset upload, checkout, publication or visitor enquiry is part of this design-selection comparison.
